namespace.description: The addon's namespace. It prefixes every screen's JSON UI namespace as <namespace>_<name>, so an addon's UI carries its own name and never collides with another addon's. Left unset, it is read from the creator/pack in core.register(), the way the other filters resolve it.

stamp.description: Draw a build stamp at the HUD's top-left — a short hash of every compiled screen plus the build clock — so a running client shows which build it is rendering.

gallery.description: Write every screen's preview — the screen as faces alone, mounted on the action form under its own title — and a gallery screen that opens each, reached as openGallery(player) from @bedrock-core/generated/ui. For a development profile.

screens.description: Modules whose default export is a record of screens to compile besides the addon's own *.screen.tsx files — a library's generic screens, e.g. "@bedrock-core/config/compiled". Each export key names the screen.
